title: 50 Ways to Leave Your Lover
release: Still Crazy After All These Years
feel: Straight 16ths with a march-like, rudimental verse

drum_performances.name: Steve Gadd
drum_performances.why_it_matters: Probably the most famous groove in pop session drumming. Opens the song on drums alone and acts as a hook. A drum-corps idea made into a radio hit.

section_map.drum_approach: Linear, rudimental groove split between hi-hat and snare, soft and contained.
Opens into a more conventional backbeat groove for lift.

notable_moments.description: Drums establish the song before any other instrument.
Low volume intricacy: complex sticking played very softly, leaving space for the vocal.
